posts.subject: [SDM] Map Cycle ?
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello guys.


I'm here to talk about the map cycle on the SDM server.


It's been something like... 1 week that the server is almost full for something like... 5/6 hours long and all the maps are too small or they have spots to spawnkill etc... And when you're alone it's hard to administrate a full server when 90% of guys are spawnkilling or breaking the rules. Especially when there is voicespam, other language and spawnkilling at the same time and when the players shout into you headphones
"X IS SPAWNKILLING" "NO I'M NOT YOU STUPID IDIOT" etc...


So yeah... Is this possible to change some little maps to bigger ones ? (Like utopia)


Kaosaren

Hey Kaosaren,


if you have maps that you want to have at the map- pool, write them in here (with the link for download).


Blackfire and Sky can watch them and choose wich one they want for the server 🙂


You can alose write Maps inside wich have to get delet.


Greetings


Mario

Well mate...


bind z "sm_slay @aim"
bind x "sm_kick @aim STOP BREAKING SERVER RULES"
bind h "sm_slap @aim; sm_drug @aim; sm_freeze @aim; sm_burn@aim; sm_timebomb @aim"
bind j "sm_msay STOP BREAKING SERVER RULES; sm_slap @all"


That should make it a lot easier for you...

Maybe, instead of kicking with the reason: "STOP BREAKING SERVER RULES", you should try "Please follow the !rules" or something less aggressive.


Here are some more admin commands and explanations in case you didn't knew already:

  • @Message - Displays your message in the text chat in completely white font
  • sm_msay Message - Displays your message in the text box, that pops up on the left side of your screen.

    • e.g. sm_msay Spawnkilling is against the !rules
  • sm_csay Message - Displays your message in the text box that pops up in the lower center of your screen
  • sm_psay PlayerName "Here is a message" - Sends a private message to a player of your choice.

    • e.g. sm_psay Nachtfris "This is a warning, please follow the !rules or you will get banned"


I've written a complete guide for admins, which explains all the different commands, menus and the web interface. The problem is that it's 17 pages long and in German. But if you are interested, I would be able to translate the guide for you. Just tell me, if you want it. I will PM you the German version, so you can at least see what you are getting into 🙂

@mar1o :) NP for that I will do some research about big maps when I've got time.


@VinceG I already got some commands from Ploiken that are kinda the same as yours


@Nachtfrische That could be a great ideam if you can translate me the principal things on your guide =) But yeah, i've already got some commands and I used them alot. But this post was first for complaining about the small size of certains map such as "colos2" aka as the Pink Fluffy Unicorn map. Or all the "10x" they are allowing so much spawnkill so yeah. As i said I will do some research

@Kaosaren
I will translate the guide for you and the new non german admins which may come in the later future.
Just give me a bit of time for the translation, since it's pretty long.


On the topic of maps: As @mar1o :) suggested, you should look for new maps on the internet, which him or Blackfire could then try. If you want to remove some maps, create a list of the maps which you want to remove and submit it here: DreamTeam - Topic
Then only admins can see your thread and you could get feedback from other admins as well.
